_comment: Ground truth from Factorio 2.1.12 via test/oracle. Tests whether CHUNK-GENERATION ORDER is the missing mechanism behind the Vulcanus ore/cliff effect (#84) - the first of the three ideas vulcanus-cliffs-NOTES.md lists as untouched after all five direct routes closed. Two levers are CROSSED: resources ON/OFF (the established autoplace_controls arm) against the order the SAME chunks are generated in (one blocking drain; or two drains splitting the region on x, or on y). Every arm records the generated chunk SET, and the two-drain arms also record the half that existed BETWEEN their drains - that snapshot is what proves the order really changed, since chunkSequenceLength is 0 everywhere (Factorio dispatches no on_chunk_generated for chunks generated during on_init). Cliffs, resource count and chunks all come from ONE surface per arm, so 'the order did not move the cliffs' can never be confused with 'the order never moved' or with 'the ore effect was absent from this run'. Regenerate: node --experimental-strip-types test/oracle/capture.ts vulcanus-cliff-chunk-order
